newFindings.title: AMO complete-book cache ignores same-block changes
newFindings.result: A retained complete book is reused at the same height/hash despite fresh=true and changed snapshot/indexedAt; the fixture makes zero new reads. Mempool ticket spends can change without a new block. No bad live purchase was demonstrated; action preflight remains separate.

newFindings.title: Credit history failure becomes a false empty result
newFindings.evidenceClass: Exact-source synthetic counterexample and dependency review
newFindings.result: Failed remote holder/mint history clears remote state and loading, then falls back to omitted local history and renders No Holders/No Mints. Refresh dependencies omit checkpoint/revision, so unchanged counts need not refresh changed records. The repaired root directory loading state remains intact.
newFindings.recommendation: Track loading, unavailable, last verified and authoritative empty separately for each history lane; invalidate on accepted source revision.

newFindings.title: Wallet UTXO reads can restore an obsolete result
newFindings.result: Same-account initial/focus/interval reads lack a response-generation fence: an older one-output response can overwrite a newer empty response. Four token lanes have their own guards. No real spend or connected-wallet incident was tested.
newFindings.recommendation: Guard UTXO acceptance by account, network and request generation, and retain independent fresh funding/anchor preflight.

newFindings.title: Monotonic summary guards reject a lower canonical branch
newFindings.evidenceClass: Bond exact-source fixture; Growth source continuation
newFindings.result: Bond summary acceptance rejects lower supply/network value even when the supplied checkpoint is a newer, different canonical branch; the old object is silently retained. Growth has the same monotonic assumption. The fixture assumes canonical branch authority; no production reorg was induced.
newFindings.recommendation: Validate branch/checkpoint authority and completeness explicitly. Distinguish stale responses from legitimate canonical decreases without weakening fail-closed validation.

newFindings.title: WORK counts a dropped transfer as pending
newFindings.evidenceClass: Live API, SQL and Core mismatch; exact-source reproduction
newFindings.result: WORK reports pendingTransfers=1 although SQL has 221 valid confirmed, zero valid pending and one dropped transfer. Transaction d13f042e40a7d0dadd8be29e1fadcae0d35803344ecd3ebf32a1089ea9b53679 is absent from Core mempool. The reproduced source counter uses !confirmed; the live mismatch was independently verified without dynamically tracing the exact runtime route. Confirmed balances and supply remain correct.
newFindings.recommendation: Count explicit valid pending lifecycle state, excluding dropped/invalid/orphaned history; keep terminal records replayable and separate membership from confirmation.

newFindings.title: Browser completion can undo a network selection
newFindings.result: Changing the selected network during a page load can be undone by completion of that old load. The proof card still uses the loaded page network; no falsely labeled chain proof was observed.
newFindings.recommendation: Invalidate or cancel the outstanding load when network selection changes.

newFindings.title: Credit form overflows a narrow viewport

newFindings.recommendation: Allow the form/select grid items to shrink and verify long credit labels at narrow widths.

newFindings.title: Infinity chart clips leading axis digits
newFindings.result: Floor-axis labels extend to x=0.31–4.89px while the SVG begins at x=32px. Leading digits are clipped even though complete decimal text exists in the DOM.

newFindings.title: Log background refresh removes a verified search
newFindings.result: Both a zero-result dropped-tx search and a one-result confirmed-tx search became Search to verify without input changes, while their success banners remained. The 15-second effect captures the initial empty query, loads a global page and replaces the filtered page; txid searches have no profile to restore. Ordinary overlapping page reads can also accept the older response last.
newFindings.recommendation: Refresh the current query/page from current scoped state, preserve a matching snapshot and generation, and bind loading/error/status to the accepted request.

newFindings.title: Log UI keys omit protocol record identity
newFindings.result: Two same-kind records in one transaction at different protocol positions receive the same UI key. The local fallback merges two fixture records into one; direct server pages have a React reconciliation risk. No collision or missing row was observed in the captured 60-head/50-page sample.
newFindings.recommendation: Use stable transaction, kind and protocol-position identity consistently. Pending internal database IDs can change during rematerialization, so an eventId-only patch is insufficient.

newFindings.title: Manual mail refresh can apply the previous account mailbox
newFindings.result: A refresh started for account A completes after switching to B and opening IDs; A mail replaces the inbox, the old folder is reopened and success is reported. Connection/sync loaders have wallet-generation guards; manual refresh lacks them. No live account-switch incident or signing bypass was observed.
newFindings.recommendation: Fence each awaited mail/status result by wallet generation, address, network and workspace; accept inbox rows only for the active account.
